messages:
Mae J: opened PR updating SDK examples for streaming retries + pagination in py/ts/go. Key fix: preserve cursor state during transient 429 retries. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9012
Omar L: Sweet. Can we add a minimal unit test that mocks a 429 on the first chunk and then a success so this doesn't regress? Integration tests will be flaky.
Mae J: Yep added py/tests/test_stream_retry.py and ts/__tests__/stream-retry.test.ts; go has a tiny mock in examples_test.go. Also included a short migration blurb explaining why clients should preserve and rehydrate cursor state after recoverable errors.
Priya S: For TypeScript snippet, prefer `stream.close()` instead of `stream.abort()` (abort is old API). Also the pagination example uses page tokens that assume sync semantics; add an async iterator example for the common JS/TS pattern.
Mae J: Good call. Updated TS snippet to use async iterator + close(). Added comment showing default retry count (5) vs example lowering to 3 for interactive apps. Python snippet included below:
```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient()
stream = client.stream("gpt-core")
for chunk in stream.retry(max_attempts=3):
    if chunk.type == "cursor":
        cursor_state = chunk.cursor  # preserve, then resume after retry
        continue
    print(chunk.text)
```
Omar L: CI is failing on gofmt in the docs repo; let's add a pre-commit hook or auto-run gofmt in the docs CI so PRs auto-fix. I can add that in a follow-up commit.
Mae J: I'll wait for the deploy preview then merge. @Docs Bot please render preview for PR #9012.
